payload.sample:
name: Vendor Gems

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - Library/Homebrew/dev-cmd/vendor-gems.rb
      - Library/Homebrew/Gemfile*
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/vendor-gems.yml
    branches-ignore:
      - main
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request:
        description: Pull request number
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash -xeuo pipefail {0}

jobs:
  vendor-gems:
    if: gith
